Description: Agentic pipeline under a fixed agent chaining that uses hub-and-spoke architecture and also keeps scratchpads for understanding the pipeline status. Also utilizes a compact artifact to handoff structured data for the analysis agent.
Preconditions: Docs in google drive not modified for 5 days.
BasicFlow: Ingestion (webhooks and polling to identify new/ready documents on drive) -> Extraction (parallel parsing of text to compact artifact) -> Analysis layer (artifact passed to fixed chain for formatting and citations) -> Routing and export (YAML frontmatter injection and local file writing).
Alternative: Documents are corrupted or API rate limit: Intelligent retries with exponential backoff or halt and handoff to human via scratchpad logging. Documents that contain images: Handle images gracefully by downloading them to a local temporary staging folder during extraction, passing only lightweight metadata (IDs and alt-text) to the compact artifact to save tokens. During export, move the images to a separated folder next to the vault and inject absolute local file URIs (e.g., `![Alt Text](file:///C:/path/to/images/...)`) into the .md file.
Postconditions: Docx -> md. Markdown files are categorized and saved inside the local Obsidian vault. Extracted images are saved outside the vault in a dedicated, separated folder.
Business: Doesnt change the semantic content, only enhance it. Automated extraction exclusively on files that haven't changed for 5 days to prevent processing works-in-progress.
Nonfunctional: Least token consumption as possible (strictly preventing raw image data or base64 strings from reaching the LLM). Organized obsidian vault.
Assumptions: Runs on windows 11, quick and accurate extraction.
